offer.title: New here? Take a 30-second tour
offer.bodyHome: See government data for your district — every number shows its source and date.
offer.bodyDistrict: A quick look at how this district page works — every number shows its source and date.

card.keys: Use the arrow keys to move between steps. Press Escape to close the tour.

search.title: Find your district
search.body: Type your district’s name, or tap “Use my location”. Every live district has its own page.

stats.title: Your district data
stats.body: How many districts are live, how much data we track, and when it was last updated.

map.title: The India map
map.body: Each pin is a live district. Tap one, or pick it from the list of live districts.

india.title: Explore all of India
india.body: The country’s big numbers in one place, each with its source and date.

language.title: Your language
language.body: Read the site in another language. You can change it here at any time.

support.title: Support
support.body: ForThePeople.in is a free, independent citizen project. If it helps you, you can support it here.

bar.title: Switch district or taluk
bar.body: Move to another state, district or taluk from here.

topics.title: Every topic
topics.body: Every dashboard for this district is listed here: weather, crop prices, schools and more.

overview.title: This district at a glance
overview.body: The main facts about this district, in short. Tap “View all” on a card to see more.

verify.title: Check this data
verify.body: See how old each dataset is and where it comes from, so you can check it yourself.

report.title: Found a mistake?
report.body: Tap “Report a problem” to tell us. It sends this page along with your note.
